ModMetaData.name: Project Momo Insects
ModMetaData.author: Gapho
ModMetaData.description:
Turns the six insectoids of the Rim into insect momos for Project Momo.
Megascarabs, spelopedes and megaspiders - and, with the Odyssey expansion, larvae, locusts and hive queens - now take the shape of monster girls: devil bugs, giant ants, soldier beetles, greenworms, vamp mosquitoes and abaddons. Every spawn source is affected: infestations and hives, ancient dangers, deep drilling, wild encounters and trader livestock alike.
The bug girls keep the exact stats of the insects they replace - the same chitin armor, health, speed, cold-blooded comfort ranges and toxin immunity, and the same mandibles and claws. Hive queens never sleep and still spew eggs, and the larvae that hatch from them are greenworm daughters.
Requires the Biotech expansion, Harmony, Big and Small - Framework, and Project Momo. The Odyssey expansion is optional: with it larvae, locusts and hive queens are also transformed; without it only the three base-game insectoids are affected.
